endCall.title: End the call?
endCall.description: Optionally record how it went. Outcomes link your performance to real results.

manualLine.placeholder: Type a line from the conversation

live.title: Live call
live.connectTitle: Connect your audio to start capturing
live.connectMeeting: Choose the meeting's browser tab and enable “Share tab audio”, then allow the microphone.
live.connectMic: Allow microphone access. Put your phone on speaker near this device.

notices.switchedToBrowser: Live transcription is unavailable. Switched to your browser's speech recognition.
notices.aiUnavailableBrowser: AI transcription is unavailable, so your browser's speech recognition is being used instead. Speaker detection may be less accurate.
notices.manualFallback: Transcription is unavailable for this audio. Add key lines manually so the co-pilot can still help.
notices.audioStopped: {{label}} audio stopped (the tab was closed or the device disconnected). What was captured is safe. Reconnect to continue.

new.title: Start a call
new.description: Pick how you're calling and which co-pilot to use. Everything except the co-pilot is optional.

noCopilot.title: Create a co-pilot first
noCopilot.description: The co-pilot uses your script, objections and knowledge to suggest what to say. It takes a minute with a template.

new.meetingUnsupported: Needs a desktop browser like Chrome or Edge.

copilot.title: Co-pilot
copilot.noneHint: No live suggestions during the call. The call is still transcribed and analyzed with the default criteria.

context.title: Call context
context.description: Helps the co-pilot personalise suggestions and the analysis.
context.goalHint: Leave empty to use the co-pilot's goal.
context.notesPlaceholder: Referred by Anna. Currently uses paper calendars.
context.autoDetectHint: Auto-detect follows whichever of the co-pilot's languages the prospect speaks.

recording.title: Recording
recording.keepHint: Turn off to get suggestions and an analysis without storing audio.

consent.title: Recording consent
consent.text: Recording laws differ by country and some require every participant's consent. You're responsible for getting it. You can enable a consent line your co-pilot suggests at the start of each call.
consent.checkbox: I understand and will get consent where it's required.

new.footerMeeting: Next, choose your meeting tab and enable “Share tab audio”.
new.footerMic: Put your phone on speaker near this device.

upload.title: Recording file
upload.dropzone: Drop an audio file here or click to browse
upload.formats: mp3, m4a, wav, webm, ogg or aac, up to 300 MB
upload.footer: We'll transcribe the recording in the background and prepare your report. You can leave this page.
upload.tooLarge: This file is larger than 300 MB
upload.cleanupHint: Recommended for noisy or low-quality audio. AI reviews the transcript before the analysis starts.
upload.cleanupDisclaimer: AI may misinterpret some phrases, and it removes speech it cannot confidently understand. The cleaned transcript may not be 100% accurate and some of the original context could be lost. The analysis will be based on the cleaned version.
